The '''Chandrilan House''' was a structure located in the center of [[Hanna City/Legends|Hanna City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. It served as the center of the planet's [[Chandrilan House|government]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
